name: How should I prepare my home before bathroom flooring installation starts?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before bathroom flooring installation starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the installation crew arrives, clear all personal belongings from vanity counters, linen closets, and floor space. Clear a walking path from the main home entrance to the bathroom to allow easy transport of tools and heavy materials. You should also turn off or plan for the temporary shutoff of the water supply to the bathroom fixtures. Taking measurements, selecting transitions that match adjacent room floors, and arranging an alternate bathroom for household use during work hours are also essential preparations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remove personal items, clear a direct path for the installers, arrange alternate bathroom facilities, and ensure water shutoff valves to the room are accessible.
